title: `registradores nota` orders a company's nota
notes: informativa mercantil at sede.registradores.org behind `--confirmar si`.
result: certificate login through the F5 front and both SAML service providers (every request sends `Connection: close`: the F5 drops kept-alive sockets after its 302s and the next request dies with ECONNRESET), search by NIF, company selection, nota and segments; the plan stops on the identification page and prints the company, `accountsDepositAvailable` and every identification field (representative from the certificate, province from `api/validate/sociedad`, town from `api/location/towns`). Confirmed, it posts identification, card payment, polls `orden-completa` and prints the hosted checkout URL (`--out` writes a page that opens it); it never pays.
evidence: live plan run 2026-10-16 for B22903801 (VIBRA LAB SL, IRUS and Registro Mercantil de Cáceres found, `accountsDepositAvailable: false`, billing town Cáceres 10/37); the confirmed path is covered by synthetic fixtures only (an order had already been created by hand that day); `pnpm check:ci` green.
